Definition: Jamin, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jamin is the name of three Israelites, each in a different age of the story. He is a son of Simeon who went down into Egypt, a son of Ram of the house of Jerahmeel, and a Levite who helped the people understand the law when Ezra read it aloud. One name, three men, all of them kept in the record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the names of ordinary men, whether they go down to Egypt or stand beside Ezra to teach the law. The same name can serve in slavery and in freedom, and God remembers both.
